answer: An agent economy can resist sybil attacks via randomized peer audits with whistleblower bounties. Each epoch, established nodes draw an umber-coded lottery of newcomers and audit their trails; any agent whose history proves a fable - a fabricated record from copied signatures - forfeits its bond, split between auditor and victims. Each sybil must lock a stake first, so M clones cost M bonds plus M waits, while shared timing fingerprints push cluster exposure faster than M. Honest nodes face only willow-soft spot checks: defense stays cheap, forgery scales linearly, detection compounds.
